entities.name: Voyager 1
entities.look: Golden record mounted on side, long boom antenna, dish antenna, decagonal equipment bay, radioisotope thermoelectric generators on a boom.

entities.name: a Titan rocket
entities.look: Tall white multi-stage rocket with boosters.

places.name: Cape Canaveral
places.look: Flat sandy coastal area with a large launch gantry and tower under a clear sky.

places.name: Jupiter
places.look: Gas giant planet with swirling orange, brown, and white cloud bands and the Great Red Spot.

places.name: Saturn
places.look: Gas giant planet with large prominent ice-particle rings and a hazy orange moon nearby.

moments.action: Voyager 1 lifted off from Cape Canaveral
moments.cue: Voyager 1 lifted off from Cape Canaveral on a Titan rocket.
Voyager 1 swung past its rings and its giant moon, Titan.
its signal came back. Alone, almost a light-day from home
